feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: 'Huna' writer wins National Book Award for non-fiction, after not being allowed into the U.S.
entry.summary: Abdelrahman ElGendy published a recent essay about being denied a visa to enter the U.S. for the ceremony. His book is a memoir about his time as a political prisoner in Egypt.

entry.title: Anthropic IPO raises record $81.3 billion on strong AI demand
entry.summary: The five-year-old artificial intelligence powerhouse priced its initial public offering at $83 a share, shrugging off growing concern about a possible AI bubble and volatility in tech stocks.

entry.title: After Nepal's epic flood, they're restoring their community ... and their lives
entry.summary: As the emergency response to the flood ends, aid workers turn to the hard work of rebuilding communities that lost everything. Many of those workers lost everything, too.

entry.title: Trump, Xi and Putin set to meet in historic summit
entry.summary: On the sidelines of a high-powered regional economic forum in China, Presidents Trump, Xi and Putin sit down for an unprecedented meeting with nuclear non-proliferation expected to be a focus.

entry.title: Democratic strategists think Montana House race could hold the secret to future wins
entry.summary: Montana is sending a Democrat to the U.S. House for the first time in three decades. Many in the party think Sam Forstag's campaign may be a playbook for how Democrats can win again in rural America.

entry.title: As overdose deaths fall, White House makes misleading claims about who deserves credit
entry.summary: In a statement celebrating the historic drop in drug deaths, the White House pointed to successes since President Trump took office. In fact, the biggest progress happened under the Biden administration.

entry.title: Karl Kani dressed hip-hop royalty for decades. Now he's telling his own story
entry.summary: On NPR's Morning Edition, fashion designer Karl Kani talks about his new memoir, dressing some of hip-hop's biggest stars and why skinny jeans aren't for everyone.

entry.title: 'I Play Rocky' and 'Elsinore' can't land their punches, even with star performances
entry.summary: Two films harken back to previous Oscar-winning movies. Elsinore, set in 1989 London, centers on Ian Charleson, co-star of Chariots of Fire. I Play Rocky tells the origin story of Sly Stallone's hit.

entry.title: Got a canceled flight? 7 clever ways to get rebooked fast
entry.summary: Flying somewhere for Thanksgiving or the holidays? Travel insiders explain what to do if your flight gets canceled or delayed — so you can quickly get to your destination.

entry.title: Democrats formally nominate Hakeem Jeffries for speaker of the House
entry.summary: The New York Democrat moved a step closer to becoming the first Black lawmaker in U.S. history to serve in the job, after House Democrats voted overwhelmingly to support him.
